name: HeroBanner
description: Responsive YAMI homepage campaign rail composed from four explicit content cards: image only, image and text, image text and products, or products only.

items.description: Ordered campaign cards. Their image, copy, and product fields select one of the four public card subcomponents.

ariaLabel.description: Localized accessible name for the campaign region.

previousLabel.description: Localized accessible name for the desktop previous-page button.

nextLabel.description: Localized accessible name for the desktop next-page button.

imageLoading.description: Native loading mode for non-leading campaign images. The first image is always eager/high priority.

dividerPosition.description: Places the optional desktop section boundary above, below, or removes it; ignored below 1024px.

dividerVariant.description: Gray uses the existing 1px structural separator; black uses the theme-aware 2px emphasis separator.

tapTarget.note: Desktop paging composes 36px YAMI icon Buttons whose transparent hit area reaches 44px.

focus.note: Campaign links and paging buttons remain keyboard reachable with visible focus.

radius.note: Campaign cards use --radius-lg (12px); product thumbnails use --radius-md (8px), matching the Figma component.

motion.note: Paging respects prefers-reduced-motion and does not animate card geometry.

accessibility.role: region containing a list of campaign links
accessibility.ariaPattern: labelled region with list/listitem campaign links and optional paging buttons
accessibility.structure: Campaign images require semantic alt text. Image-only cards use the image alt as the link accessible name.
accessibility.interaction: Mobile uses native horizontal scrolling. Desktop paging buttons reuse ProductList rail navigation and disable at boundaries, while the progress track and aria-live count report how many banners have been revealed through the current viewport against the total banner count.
